title: FOOTBALL | Zakari Tillman Press Conference - 11/27/26
text: Gar, you Mississippi guy. You got to be a captain today. I mean, you know, how important is this game to you and the Mississippi guys? I know it's not like it used to be. You don't have quite as many Mississippi guys on either roster, but what's the importance of this game? >> Uh, definitely important game for me. Um, you know, just the history of the game itself in this state. You know, I take a lot of pride in it just being from Florence, Mississippi, and you know, just being able to represent the people of this city and myself. You know, it just means a whole lot to me. Sam, >> have you made any decisions yet about what you're going to do for next season or still something you're thinking about at this point? >> Um, yeah. Is this something I'm still thinking about? Uh, most likely planning to come back and [clears throat] be bulldog. [clears throat] >> You got a a clean sack on on Trinidad today. It felt like defensively early on had a real edge. You held him to two to just two field goals in the first half. What were you guys feeling at the half that maybe gave you a confidence you could go finish this day? >> Uh, honestly during the half we felt like we had them. We felt like we had right where we wanted them. You know, uh, defense coming out first. We expected to get a three and out, but you know, it didn't go as planned and, you know, we just kind of let it get to us. Um, just being able to maintain and sustain like the same energy as you said at the beginning of the game. Sam, >> if you do end up deciding to come back for next season, what just makes you believe in coach Levby and the team for 2027? >> Uh, I have a lot of belief in Coach Levby and what he's chasing for this program. Um, you know, I've been here, you know, since he's been here. So, you know, I have great belief in what he's uh going to do for this program and, you know, I feel like Kamario and, you know, guys that are planning to come back, you know, will be able to lead this program into the right direction. >> James, >> what kinds of things are you going to try to take into consideration when making this decision? >> Um, I don't know. It was kind of a hard person to answer, but the one thing I am going to take into consideration is just knowing that I'm around the right guys with the same mindset as me. >> Steve, speaking of that, so what's it been like having coach Arnett and coach coach Brock back for like a full season and how they've utilized you? Are you comfortable with that role? >> Absolutely. I love being coached up by Coach Arnett and Coach Brock because it's like they put a battery in my back and I know what they expect and um you know they've known me since I was 17 and you know just my mindset and their mindset and like I said I know what they expect out of me. So I want to be able to give them that every time they call them. Colin, >> I know there's been a lot of looking you know looking forward for the program and trying to build again next year but a lot of guys on the defense especially you know this was their last ride. What was the mood like in the locker room with them knowing that this was, you know, their last time out? >> Um, you know, we'll say it just to see how it all played out. Um, you know, we did what we could and you know, just being able to lean on them guys as they, you know, get ready to leave playing that last game and, you know, it's it's rough. It's rough, especially some of the transfers, you know, see transfer seniors that we had coming in. You know, you just hate to see it. Hate to see that their their season had to, you know, end the way that it did. But, you know, [snorts] just still leaning on guys and you know, just letting them uh know you love them. You know what I mean? That's just what it was. >> Anything else for All right. Thank you guys. >> Appreciate
